name: Channel/component temporarily unavailable
description: Update of the firmware is being performed or has been canceled. The module does not perform any measurements during this time.
remedy: ● Restart firmware update ● Wait for firmware update

name: Overtemperature
description: ● Ambient temperature is too high ● Short-circuit or overload of one or more digital outputs/sensor supplies
remedy: ● Check wiring ● Eliminate the cause of the excess temperature and restart the module

name: Wire break
description: ● Impedance of encoder circuitry is too high ● Wire break between the module and sensor ● Channel not connected (open)
remedy: ● Use a different encoder type or modify the wiring, for example, using cables with a larger cross-section ● Connect the cable ● Disable diagnostics ● Connect the encoder contacts

name: High limit violated
description: ● The analog value is above the overrange. ● Short-circuit of input to L+
remedy: Correct the module/encoder tuning

name: Low limit violated
description: The analog value is below the underrange.
remedy: Correct the module/encoder tuning

name: Parameter assignment error
description: ● Parameter assignment does not match the terminal block used ● Incorrect parameter assignment
remedy: ● Correct the parameter assignment ● Check terminal block1

name: Supply voltage missing
description: Missing or insufficient supply voltage L+
remedy: ● Check wiring of the supply voltage L+ on the terminal block ● Check the terminal block type

name: Hardware interrupt lost
description: Error is reported because the events occur faster than they can be processed in the system

name: Module is faulty
description: Internal module error has occurred
remedy: Replace module

name: Short-circuit to L+
description: Short-circuit of the analog input to sensor supply or L+
remedy: Correct the process wiring

name: Short-circuit/overload at external encoder supply
description: ● Short-circuit of the encoder supply to ground ● Encoder supply overload
remedy: ● Correct the module/ encoder tuning ● Check the wiring

name: Inconsistent parameter assignment
description: Error in the redundancy parameters transferred to the module
remedy: ● Check the parameter assignment ● Check the slot and terminal block

name: Retentive memory in carrier module defective
description: Fault detected in the data block on the carrier module during operation
remedy: Replace carrier module

name: Retentive memory in the terminal block defective
description: A memory block error was detected on the terminal block during operation
remedy: Replace terminal block

name: Redundancy partner has different hardware/firmware version
description: The redundantly configured and interconnected I/O modules are not compatible
remedy: Check and replace modules

name: IO redundancy warning
description: Unable to correctly communicate with the partner module
remedy: ● Check/replace right module ● Check/replace left module ● Check/replace terminal block See also system manual Distributed I/O System; ET 200SP HA", section "Replacing an I/O module for I/O redundancy"

name: HART communication error
description: ● HART field device is not responding ● Timing error ● HART field device did not understand the command that was sent (1st status byte)
remedy: ● Check the process wiring ● Correct the parameter assignment ● Set current ≥4 mA ● Increase number of configured repetitions

name: HART primary variable outside of limits
description: ● Incorrect parameters in the HART field device ● HART field device is set to "Primary variable outside of limits" in simulation mode ● Incorrect measuring point ● Parameter assignment of primary variable outside of limits
remedy: ● Check the parameter assignment of the HART device ● Correct the simulation ● Check whether the correct measuring transducer is connected

name: HART analog output current of the field device is saturated
description: ● The output current of the HART field device is saturated: ● Incorrect parameters in the HART field device ● HART field device is set to a measured value that is too high in simulation mode ● Incorrect measuring point

name: HART output current of the field device specified
description: ● The output current of the HART field device is fixed: ● Incorrect parameters in the HART field device ● HART field device is set to a measured value that is too high in simulation mode ● Incorrect measuring point

name: HART additional status information available
description: In the HART device status (in the 2nd status byte), the HART field device identifier for "further status information available" has been set
remedy: Read out status with HART command 48 and clear error/ cause if necessary

name: HART configuration changed1
description: In the HART device status (in the 2nd status byte), the identifier for "parameter reassignment" of the HART field device has been set
remedy: If no diagnostics interrupt is to be triggered by reconfiguration, the HART diagnostics must be disabled.

name: HART malfunction in the field device
description: In the HART device status (in the 2nd status byte) the field device reports a malfunction
remedy: ● Read out status with HART command 48 and clear error/cause if necessary ● Replace the field device

name: HART secondary variable outside the limits
description: ● Incorrect parameters in the HART field device ● HART field device is set to "Non-primary variable outside limits" in simulation mode ● Incorrect measuring point ● Parameter assignment of non-primary variable is outside the limits
remedy: ● Check the parameter assignment of the HART device ● Correct the simulation ● Check whether the correct measuring transducer is connected
